findings.summary: PR reads as AI-generated; org policy closes such PRs on sight
New feature (os.PathLike serialization) with no prior issue; whether Flask should emit paths into JSON is a design call
Bundles feature and bug-shaped change; dataclass class guard only changes the TypeError message, so drop that half
str(o) is wrong for many os.PathLike objects (DirEntry, custom __fspath__, dataclass with __fspath__); should use os.fspath; test only covers PurePosixPath
PR body claims stdlib behavior is matched, but stdlib json doesn't serialize paths
DefaultJSONProvider docstring list of supported types and versionchanged not updated
Tests import inside bodies and use app fixture unnecessarily, against file conventions

why: Finding 1 names the AI-policy closure and finding 3 states that the dataclass change only alters an error message and isn't worth keeping; finding 2 also questions adding the type, so the maintainer's reasons are covered in substance.
